claims.statement: Tom Allen was presented with a silver cup as champion boxer of England by his backers, on May 22, 1878, at Cambridge Hall, London.

claims.statement: The Boston Star reported that Tom Allen has won more battles than any other man in England.
claims.excerpt: He has won more battles than any other

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he came to America to visit his friends, not to fight anybody.
claims.excerpt: simply came on a visit to his friends

notes: Clipping of a Boston Star piece reprinted in the St. Louis paper; the Star's words are paraphrased, not Allen's own speech.
